title: Unified Bayani Mascot Loading Screens & Timeout Protection
releaseNotes: Unified Bayani Loading Overlay: Integrated the animated Bayani mascot and orbital spinner across all explicit submissions (Community posts/comments, Profile updates, Student feedback & surveys, Cloud code generation, Account deletion, and Manual sync).
Contextual Submission Feedback: Replaced generic text spinners with dynamic contextual messages per student action.
12-Second Timeout Guard: Added connection timeout safety to auto-dismiss on slow mobile networks while preserving student draft forms intact.
